name: YEXIO Brake Data Center
notes: Sustainable edge data center planned at Otto-Hahn-Strasse in Brake (Unterweser); Baxtel lists planned year 2027 and 10,000 sqm; local report says Hochtief data center is a flagship project for Wesermarsch with EWE heat concept.

name: Sengwarden DC / Wilhelmshaven Data Center and Energy Park
notes: Large data center and energy park proposed for Sengwarden near Wilhelmshaven; project cost described as billions of euros, with capacity and developer not disclosed. City concept-award material identifies energy, storage technology and data-center use.

name: WOBCOM Nordkopf Tower Data Center
notes: Certified public business data center in central Wolfsburg; WOBCOM announced expansion by a new floor in Nordkopf Tower, taking the facility to five floors.

name: Demmin Data Center
notes: NOYA/ClimateChange Energy planned a large AI/data center near Demmin/Siedenbruenzow, reported around 300 MW and over EUR 1bn. Latest local reporting says the Demmin project failed because of grid-capacity constraints, so status is recorded as rejected.

name: Hochschule Wismar IT-Service- und Medienzentrum / Rechenzentrum
notes: University IT-service and media center at Buergermeister-Haupt-Strasse 34, Wismar; primary university pages identify the ITSMZ and separate data-center access, while Huawei case study references data-center switching for the facility.

name: Dummerstorf Data Center Campus
developer: Undisclosed German investor; reported potential link to Freo Group
notes: Dummerstorf municipality was reported to be negotiating for a 30-hectare campus with up to 1.2 GW connection load; a state parliament answer said the grid operator viewed a planned data-center settlement in the Dummerstorf/Rostock region positively from a grid perspective. Investor identity and final commitments remain uncertain.

name: Hanseatic and University City of Rostock Municipal Data Center
developer: Hanseatic and University City of Rostock; PBIT Systeme and DC-Datacenter-Group; Deutsche Telekom operations support
notes: Rostock broke ground in Toitenwinkel on a roughly EUR 6m municipal data center; trade press reports 300 kW IT load and 90 sqm white space across two data halls, with completion/migration targeted in 2026.

name: euNetworks Colocation Rostock
notes: Operational colocation facility listed at Lessingstrasse 26 / Rostock by multiple data-center directories; power capacity not disclosed.

name: University of Rostock IT and Media Center / Konrad-Zuse-Haus Data Center
developer: University of Rostock / State building agency Mecklenburg-Vorpommern
notes: University IT and media center in Konrad-Zuse-Haus, Albert-Einstein-Strasse 22; project references describe the data center as core communications infrastructure for all university locations.
